class.name: NavigationTraversalRules3D
class.brief_description: Search settings, body size and creature profiles for baking traversal surfaces.
class.description: Assign to [member NavigationRegion3D.traversal_rules]. After the walking mesh is baked, traversal candidates are searched between boundary edges of the mesh using the search and body settings of this resource. Every candidate is checked against each [NavigationTraversalProfile3D] in [member profiles]; the accepted ones become traversal surfaces whose [code]layers[/code] mask holds the [member NavigationTraversalProfile3D.layer_bit] of every profile that accepted them. Profile ids and layer bits must be unique. Duplicates are reported by [method get_validation_warnings], as configuration warnings of the region and when baking.

method.name: get_all_layers
method.description: Returns the combined layer mask of all profiles.

method.name: get_layers_for
method.description: Returns the layer mask of the profile with [param id], or [code]0[/code] if there is no such profile. Use it for [member NavigationPathQueryParameters3D.traversal_layers].

method.name: get_profile
method.description: Returns the first profile with [param id], or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_validation_warnings
method.description: Returns a warning for every empty profile, profile without id, duplicate id and duplicate layer bit.

method.name: has_profile
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a profile with [param id] exists.
